resolutions.note: EO 12163 is the parent order that section 1 amends, not a later actor; its continued force is the clause's current predicate, so no later event applies.
EO 13637 revokes EO 11958 (section 2's parent) and is recorded as section 2's end; the sentence names it only to explain why it does not reach section 1, whose parent EO 12163 it does not name.

EO 12292 section 8 (1981-02-23) revokes only paragraph 1-201(a)(14) of EO 12163, a different provision and predating EO 12423; it does not touch section 1-301(b) and EO 12163 remained amendable by EO 12423 in 1983.
